column1: Account correctly transitions through delinquency states and triggers notifications
System prevents invalid direct state transition from 'Current' to 'In Collections'
Notifications are suppressed based on specific account conditions
'Due Reminder' is sent on the first day of the window but not before
'Overdue Alert' is triggered immediately after the due date passes midnight
'Collection Notification' is triggered on the exact 30th day of delinquency
PII (PAN) is correctly masked in all notifications and channels
Financial data in 'Collection Notification' matches the core banking ledger
'Overdue Balance Alert' is suppressed if a full payment is posted moments before the job runs
System gracefully handles notification service API unavailability
System handles invalid customer contact information without halting the batch
A single account progresses through the full delinquency lifecycle
Collection lifecycle is interrupted and halted by a full payment
Collection lifecycle is suppressed by an active dispute flag
